exposure: mode of Copper T 380A insertion (vaginal vs. intracaesarean)
outcome: incidence of complications (cramping pain abdomen, irregular vaginal bleeding, abnormal vaginal discharge, string problems, perforation)
cohort: The study participants were 210 consecutive eligible postpartum mothers who delivered either vaginally or by caesarean section.
finding: Copper T 380A is an acceptable, safe, effective, and convenient contraceptive method with a good continuation rate in the immediate postpartum period, regardless of the mode of delivery.
mod_finding: The intracaesarean insertion group showed significantly higher compliance-continuation rates and lower incidences of abnormal vaginal bleeding, foul smelling vaginal discharge, string problems, and expulsions compared to the vaginal insertion group.
